summary: A two-week period (Aug 28 - Sep 11) that covers the single worst 36 hours on this account and then a quiet, unresolved drift. It opened with three separate underpricing reports on Aug 28 ('They keep sending 4 min videos for 20 dollars please tell them to stop', 23:54) and then on Aug 29 she reported losing a high spender and roughly $300 because nobody passed on a fan request - 'Plead communicate this we lost out on 300'. Fred never answered a single message in that sequence and still has not, 13 days later, despite three Mayson escalations. From Aug 30 his conduct genuinely changed: he paused the chat team three separate times (Aug 31 on a $750 custom his chatters had already started collecting on, Sep 2 on Teddi's call request, Sep 4 on Teddi's questions) rather than push without her, and she thanked him - 'Thanks for communicating' (Sep 2). But the CRM notes he promised on Aug 30 failed inside 48 hours: on Sep 4 she posted screenshots showing chatters 'acting shocked' about Teddi's car-crash backstory she had handed over on Sep 2, and she had to phone her top spender personally to save him ('Okay just got off the phone we are good! Just made some shit up' / 'He's staying on OF'). The second week went almost silent on OnlyFans - Fred has not posted since Sep 4 10:22, seven days - while a new systemic failure surfaced on Sep 10: Michelle chased content for the management-run Instagram Reels account and Lilia replied 'Wait u guys have an account for me?'. That Drive was handed to her on Jun 12 and re-handed by Mayson on Aug 30; 91 days on it is empty, the account is still only 'being warmed up', and the client did not know it existed. Nothing on the stale stack closed: the reselling chatter is still unnamed (49 days), the two Aug 26 instructions are 16 days unanswered, the $100/min shower custom is 31 days idle, the Adam West red set is 23 days unsold, TikTok is 24 days old with zero mentions from anyone across the entire two weeks, and the $192 ledger gap is 17 days unreconciled underneath an unpaid invoice.

health.rationale: Down from 60. The Aug 30 - Sep 4 improvement in Fred's conduct was real but it did not survive the second week: he has not posted a message since Sep 4 10:22 and the one thing he built - Teddi's CRM notes - measurably failed on Sep 4 ('And the chatters are acting shocked. It should be in the notes'), forcing her to phone her highest spender herself to keep him. That is the second time in twelve days she has personally done ALTR's retention work, after already having lost a spender and ~$300 on Aug 29 to the same root cause and getting no reply in 13 days. Nothing on the carried-over stack closed: 49 days since the reselling chatter was supposed to be named, 31 days on an accepted $100/min custom, 24 days on TikTok with literally zero mentions from anyone in this window, 23 days on the Adam West red set, 17 days on the $192. And a new failure surfaced on Sep 10 that is worse than any of them individually - she did not know ALTR runs an Instagram Reels account for her, 91 days after Michelle handed her the Drive, and it is still empty. Holding the score up: Teddi is retained and she confirmed 'He's staying on OF' (Sep 4), she reported real revenue on Sep 2, the custom-approval rule agreed Aug 31 has held for 11 days with no violation, Michelle's DMCA breakdowns landed on time twice (Sep 1, Sep 8), and she raised zero chatter complaints in the final seven days. The quiet second week is not evidence of repair - she was off content ('it's that time of month', Sep 4) and travelling to LA for shoots.
